text: Playground available in Cloud Console without needing an API key or install
quote: Use the playground in the Cloud Console — no key or install needed.

text: Existing OpenAI-based apps can switch to Cerebras by changing API key, base URL, and model ID
quote: Existing applications can use Cerebras by changing the API key, base URL, and model ID.

text: OpenAI API compatibility lets developers build on Cerebras with only two code changes
quote: OpenAI API compatibility lets developers build on Cerebras with just two code changes.

text: API supports streaming responses that are sent back incrementally in chunks
quote: The Cerebras API supports streaming responses, which send messages back in chunks and display them incrementally as the model generates them.

text: Structured Outputs constrains model responses to a JSON schema for reliable parsing
quote: Structured Outputs constrains model responses to a JSON schema so applications can process generated data reliably.

text: Supports tool calling / function calling so models can invoke app-defined functions
quote: Tool calling, also known as tool use or function calling, lets a model request functions that your application defines.

text: Batch API lets you submit groups of requests for asynchronous processing
quote: The Batch API lets you process groups of requests asynchronously, making it perfect for workloads where you don't need immediate results

text: Dedicated endpoints provide a private, reserved inference instance exclusive to your org
quote: A dedicated endpoint is a private, provisioned instance of the Cerebras Inference service reserved exclusively for your organization.

text: Dedicated endpoint runs on reserved, unshared capacity so performance isn't affected by other customers' workloads
quote: Your endpoint runs on reserved capacity that is not shared with other customers, so your performance is never impacted by other workloads.

text: Custom fine-tuned models can be deployed alongside standard model variants
quote: Deploy your custom fine-tuned models alongside standard model variants.

text: Documentation guide helps you pick the right model for your use case
quote: Use this guide to find the right model for your use case on Cerebras.

text: Cached tokens don't count toward the uncached TPM limit, so higher cache hit rate lets you process more total tokens
quote: Cached tokens don't count toward your uncached TPM limit, so a higher cache hit rate lets you process far more total tokens within the same uncached limit.

text: Self-serve paid tier offers 10x higher rate limits than the free tier and higher priority processing
quote: Self-serve payment starting at just $10 * 10x higher rate limits than free tier * Higher priority processing

text: Supports standard OpenAI image_url content shape for image inputs via base64 data URI
quote: The standard OpenAI `image_url` content shape is supported. Supply the image as a base64 data URI

text: Also accessible via partner APIs
quote: Get access to Cerebras Inference through our partner APIs

text: SDK sends warm-up requests to /v1/tcp_warming on construction to reduce time-to-first-token
quote: This SDK has a mechanism that sends a few requests to `/v1/tcp_warming` upon construction to reduce the TTFT.

text: Official Python SDK installable via pip (cerebras_cloud_sdk)
quote: pip install --upgrade cerebras_cloud_sdk

text: Doc catalog highlights open-source model alternatives to Claude, GPT, and Gemini
quote: Find the right open-source model for your workload on Cerebras, including alternatives for Claude, GPT, and Gemini.

text: Official TypeScript/JavaScript library provides server-side access to the Cerebras REST API
quote: This library provides convenient access to the Cerebras REST API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.

text: Docs let you browse all models available on Cerebras public endpoints
quote: Browse all models available on Cerebras public endpoints.

text: Free tier includes $5 in credit to prototype prompts, agents, and real-time apps before paying
quote: Get started with $5 in free credit after creating an account. Prototype prompts, agents, and real-time apps before you spend a dollar.
